name: roman-budhathoki
description: Portfolio and booking website for Roman Budhathoki, violinist.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @roman/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @roman/shared" "npm run dev -w @roman/server" "npm run dev -w @roman/client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @roman/shared && npm run build -w @roman/server && npm run build -w @roman/client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @roman/shared && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w @roman/shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.seed:admin: npm run build -w @roman/shared && npm run seed:admin -w @roman/server --
scripts.seed:content: npm run build -w @roman/shared && npm run seed:content -w @roman/server --
scripts.cleanup:media: npm run build -w @roman/shared && npm run cleanup:media -w @roman/server --
scripts.test:cloudinary: npm run build -w @roman/shared && npm run test:cloudinary -w @roman/server
scripts.check: npm run check:no-js && npm run check:lockfile && npm run check:client-secrets && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm test
